title: Raja Ravi Varma Heritage Foundation included in World Book of Records for Preserving India’s Artistic Legacy
excerpt: Bengaluru, Karnataka: Raja Ravi Varma Heritage Foundation has been officially included in World Book of Records for its exemplary dedication to preserving and promoting the artistic legacy
content:
Known for his realistic techniques, intricate detailing, sublime colour palette, and ability to capture deep emotion, Raja Ravi Varma painted over 2,000 works that brought Indian mythology and royalty vividly to life.

The certification ceremony was held at the Foundation’s premises in Bengaluru, Karnataka, in a dignified gathering that celebrated India’s rich cultural and artistic heritage. The certificate was formally presented to Rukmini Varma, Chairperson of RRVHF; Gitanjali Maini, Managing Trustee & CEO, Jay Varma, Trustee; Manu S. Pillai, Lead Researcher; and Dr. Choodamani Nandagopal, Tagore and UNESCO Fellow, Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) and National Museum, New Delhi.

The honour was bestowed by Advo. Santosh Shukla, CEO World Book of Records, accompanied by Vikram Trivedi, High Court Advocate; Shikha Sharma, Director of Kanti Sweets; Mehnaaz Nadiawala, Film Producer; and Pallavi Tripathi. This recognition celebrates the Foundation’s vital role in safeguarding India’s cultural and artistic legacy for generations to come.
author: Editorial Desk

title: Telgu Superstar Nandamuri Balakrishna Honoured by World Book of Records UK for 50 Glorious Years in Cinema
excerpt: CM N Chandrababu Naidu says, Congratulations to our dear Balayya on this historic milestone.
content:
Telugu cinema icon Nandamuri Balakrishna has been honoured by World Book of Records UK, marking his extraordinary achievement of completing 50 years in the film industry. With this distinction, he becomes the first Telugu actor to receive such an international recognition.

The felicitation ceremony was held in Hyderabad, where the official certificate was presented by Adv. Santosh Shukla, CEO World Book of Records.

The ceremony was graced by several eminent personalities, including Bandi Sanjay Kumar (Union Minister, Government of India), Nara Lokesh (Minister for Human Resources Development of Andhra Pradesh), Jayasudha (Actress), Usman Khan (Bollywood Music Director), Raneesh Perambra, Dr. Suchita Shukla and WBR Chartered Officers Dr. Rajeev Shrivastav and Dr. U. Eliyazar. Balakrishna’s family member Tejaswani, Brahmani Nara and Bhuvaneshwari Nara were also present.

The recognition has drawn widespread appreciation from across the film fraternity. Legendary superstar Rajinikanth extended his wishes, remarking that “Balakrishna’s character exudes positivity and strength.” Several veteran actors and actresses from Bollywood also congratulated him on this golden milestone.

World Book of Records UK, is a leading global institution that documents remarkable achievements, heritage, and contributions of individuals and organizations across continents. Beyond maintaining records, the organization actively promotes global brotherhood, peace, and environmental sustainability.

On this special occasion, members of the Central Working Committee of World Book of Records and international dignitaries congratulated Balakrishna for his remarkable journey and contribution to Indian cinema.
author: Editorial Desk

title: Shri Saurashtra Patel Seva Samaj included in World Book of Records for conducting 160 motivational Thursday sessions
excerpt: Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendrabhai Patel with ministers, legislators, industrialists, social leaders, trustees, and representatives of various organizations attended the grand ceremony.
content:
Gujarat/India: Shri Saurashtra Patel Seva Samaj, Surat celebrated a momentous occasion with the grand Lokarpan Ceremony of the newly developed Jamnaba Vidyarthi Bhavan, held in the distinguished presence of Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendrabhai Patel. The event marked a significant milestone in the organization’s longstanding commitment to education, social welfare, and community development.

Adding to the significance of the occasion, Shri Saurashtra Patel Seva Samaj was included in World Book of Records for successfully conducting 160 motivational Thursday sessions on the themes of Health, Wealth, and Happiness between 16 March 2023 and 21 May 2026 at Maniben Patel Chowk, Valak Junction, Surat. These sessions have played a vital role in inspiring individuals, promoting positive thinking, and encouraging social awareness within the community.

The prestigious recognition was presented by prominent representatives of World Book of Records including Santosh Shukla, CEO; Dr. Ashwinbhai Trivedi and Divyangkumar Gandhi, Chartered Officer, Gujarat. The dignitaries commended the organization for its outstanding contribution to youth motivation, educational advancement, health awareness, and community service.

Witnessed by a large gathering of community members and well-wishers, the newly inaugurated Jamnaba Vidyarthi Bhavan stands as a symbol of educational empowerment and social progress. The trustees and office bearers of Shri Saurashtra Patel Seva Samaj expressed sincere gratitude to all supporters and participants for contributing to the success of this historic event.
author: Editorial Desk

title: Astha Foundation included in World Book of Records for Mass Painting Event with Specially Abled Children
excerpt: Astha Foundation included in World Book of Records for successfully organizing a large-scale mass painting event involving specially abled children.
content:
The ceremony was held on 19 May 2026 from 11:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. at Parivartan School for Specially Abled, Vadodara, Gujarat. The unique initiative brought children who expressed their creativity through paintings centered on nature and global themes, showcasing their artistic talents, imagination, and awareness of environmental and worldwide issues.

The program aimed to encourage inclusivity, self-expression, and confidence among children with special needs while providing them with a platform to demonstrate their abilities. Throughout the day, participants enthusiastically created colorful artworks reflecting messages of harmony, environmental conservation, peace, and global unity.

In recognition of this inspiring achievement and its positive social impact, the World Book of Records bestowed a prestigious certificate upon Astha Foundation. The certificate was formally presented by Chartered Officer Divyang Gandhi to Renukaben Nileshkumar Panchal, President of Astha Foundation.

Speaking on the occasion, representatives of the foundation expressed gratitude to the students, teachers, volunteers, parents, and supporters whose collective efforts made the event a grand success. The recognition highlights Astha Foundation’s commitment to empowering specially abled children and promoting social inclusion through creative and educational initiatives. The achievement stands as a proud moment for Vadodara and serves as an inspiration for organizations working toward the welfare and development of children with special needs.
author: Editorial Desk

title: World Book of Records Hosts International Summit & Awards in Nepal
excerpt: International delegates and Nepalese leaders unite to recognise excellence in arts, healthcare, public service and entrepreneurship
content:
The International Summit and Award Ceremony of World Book of Records was held at Regal Ballroom of Hotel Yak & Yeti, Kathmandu, bringing together eminent personalities from across the globe. The prestigious ceremony celebrated excellence, innovation, and outstanding achievements across diverse fields including arts, science, social service, entrepreneurship, and public service.

It witnessed the presence of distinguished dignitaries, with Bhawani Rana, most inspiring and influential women of Nepal and Former President of FNCCI as Chief Guest including Nepalese Leaders First MP Indira Rana Magar, Former Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives along with Ojaswee Sherchand, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Mingma David Sherpa, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Sandeep Rana, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Bharat Giri, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Ramesh Kumar Malla, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Kshitij Thebe, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Rina Upreti, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Radhika Ramtel, Member of Parliament, Nepal; Ambika Devi Sangraula, Member of Parliament, Nepal and Dr. Dhananjay Regmi, Member of Parliament, Nepal.

Special guests included Dr. Satish Shukla, Renowned Surgical Oncologist; Sanjay Shukla, Ex-MLA, Madhya Pradesh, India; Sanjeev Dubey, Senior BJP Politician, Santosh Shukla, CEO of World Book of Records UKand Advo. Vikram Trivedi. International representation featured Sangita Shreshta Einhaus, Managing Director, Dwarika’s Group of Hotels & Resorts; Jacqueline Leigh Lenick from United States, Karma Tenzing Gurung, Rameshwar Aryal; Udaya Shumsher Rana; Dr. Malini Eaganathan from Malaysia; Lamsal Sudhan; and Satyakala Tamang Lama, Chairperson, A.M.S. Music and Entertainment.

The ceremony recognised a wide spectrum of achievers across multiple domains. In the field of arts and culture, awards were presented to Madan Krishna Shrestha, Basundhara Bhusal, Meera Rana, Tulsi Ghimire, Basanta Shrestha, Deep Tuladhar, Usha Sherchan, Rojin Shakya, and Bhairab Bahadur Thapa for their exceptional contributions along with prominent Nepalese Nirnaya NSK, and Sareesha Shrestha.

Healthcare and scientific excellence were represented by Prativa Pandey, Sudip Shrestha, Basanta Pant, Subash Phuyal, Buddha Basnyat, Raju Dhakal, Adarsha Kumar Singh, and Sumeet Suseelan. Entrepreneurship and industry leaders honoured included Bharat Basnet, Nicholas Pandey, Ravi Jung Lamichhane, and Paresh Rughani.

Social impact and activism awards were conferred upon Sur Bahadur Shrestha, Priya Sigdel, Yadav Lal Kayastha, Saurav Rimal, Buddha Tsering Moktan, Shova Tamang, Samiksha Rai, along with organisations such as Himani Trust, Prisoner’s Assistance Nepal, Nepal Snehi Kaakha, Hari Gopal Pradhan from Nepal Cancer Niwaran Pratisthan, and Nepal Women’s Wrestling Foundation.

Recognition was also extended to institutions and businesses including Hotel Yak & Yeti, International Sound Services, Swift Holidays, OSR Digital Nepal, Sairam Pictures, and Lord of the Drinks. In the fields of sports, fashion, and creative industries, honourees included Mehboob Alam, Gyani Shova Tuladhar, Bishnu Gopal Shrestha and Dolly Gurung. Young achievers and emerging talents such as Aarya Nikee Thinnaluri, Sara Abhijeet Vartak, Varun Vanam, Aviraj Tiwari, and Pratiyush Yadav were also recognised for their promising contributions.
author: Marcus Okafor

title: Cross-Country Kayaking Expedition for Ocean Conservation Earns World Record
excerpt: A unique cross-country kayaking expedition aimed at promoting ocean conservation has earned recognition from World Book of Records.
content:
The remarkable journey was led by scuba diving instructor SB Aravind and involved a team of 19 kayakers who paddled from India to Sri Lanka and back to raise awareness about marine pollution and the urgent need to protect ocean ecosystems.

The expedition commenced on May 20 from Holy Island in Rameswaram and was inaugurated by Ramanathapuram District Collector Simranjeet Singh Kahlon along with local police officials. The team successfully completed the challenging voyage, returning to Dhanushkodi after spending nearly 16 hours in the ocean. World Book of Records certificate was bestowed by Chartered Officer Ankita Shah.

The group consisted of 19 participants, including children aged 12 to 16 years, travelling in nine kayaks. Despite being experienced swimmers and divers, the team faced difficult weather conditions, particularly strong winds during the return journey. Their determination and teamwork enabled them to overcome these challenges and complete the mission successfully.

Aravind, who has more than two decades of experience in scuba diving and marine conservation, emphasized that the expedition was designed to inspire environmental responsibility among younger generations. He regularly participates in underwater cleanup activities, removing plastic waste and ghost nets that threaten marine species such as dugongs, whale sharks, turtles, and other aquatic life.

Accompanying him was his daughter, TA Thaaragai Aarathana, an 11-year-old scuba diver and environmental advocate. Together, they have undertaken several awareness campaigns and record-setting initiatives. The expedition’s central message.
author: Priya Sharma

title: Holkar Science College Hosts National Workshop on Urban Forests and RET Plants
excerpt: A two-day national workshop on “Development of Urban Forest, Nursery Management and Conservation of Rare, Endangered and Threatened (RET) Plant Species” commenced at Government Holkar (Model Autonomous) Science College in Indore.
content:
The event is being organised by the Departments of Horticulture and Microbiology in collaboration with Vijnana Bharati. A key highlight of the workshop was the recognition of traditional knowledge holders.

World Book of Records honoured Vaidyas (traditional healers) who came from remote and interior regions of Madhya Pradesh, along with forest guards, for their invaluable ethnomedicinal knowledge. Research papers documenting their traditional healing practices have also been published, bringing wider recognition to their contributions.

The accolade was presented by eminent dignitaries including Dr. Rajesh Lal Mehra; MPPSC Chairman, Dr. R. K. Singhai; Vice Chancellor DAVV, Santosh Shukla, CEO World Book of Records and Dr. Vinod Bhandari. Keynote addresses were delivered by PC Dubey, Patanjali Jha, and SK Billore, who emphasized the importance of biodiversity conservation.

During the discussions, the therapeutic potential of plants such as black turmeric was highlighted, including ongoing research in cancer treatment. Also present at the event were Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram national head Girish Kuber and Shivkant Vijayvargiya, along with Indore forest circle officer Lal Sudhakar.

The program concluded with Principal Anamika Jain extending a warm welcome and vote of thanks to all dignitaries by Prof. Capt. Dr. Sanjay Vyas. The workshop highlighted the importance of integrating traditional knowledge with modern scientific research to promote sustainable environmental conservation and healthcare solutions.
author: Arjun Patel

title: Dr. Vinod Bhandari Honored by World Book of Records for Excellence in Healthcare and Community Services
excerpt: In recognition of his outstanding contributions to the medical field, Dr. Vinod Bhandari, Chairman of SAIMS, Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences, and Bhandari Hospitals.
content:
The accolade was presented by eminent dignitaries including Dr. Rajesh Lal Mehra; MPPSC Chairman, Dr. R. K. Singhai; Vice Chancellor DAVV, Santosh Shukla, CEO World Book of Records and Prof. Capt. Dr. Sanjay Vyas.

Dr. Bhandari has played a transformative role in advancing healthcare and medical education in the region. Under his leadership, SAIMS has grown into a premier institution known for its modern infrastructure, quality medical training, and patient-centric services. His vision has consistently focused on integrating advanced technology with compassionate care, ensuring accessible and affordable healthcare for all sections of society.

Bhandari Hospitals, guided by his expertise, have also earned a strong reputation for delivering high standards of treatment across various specialties. His efforts have significantly contributed to improving healthcare delivery systems and strengthening medical infrastructure in Madhya Pradesh.

World Book of Records recognition stands as a testament to Dr. Bhandari’s unwavering dedication, leadership, and commitment to excellence. His achievements continue to inspire professionals in the healthcare sector and reinforce the importance of innovation, service, and integrity in medicine.
author: Chen Wei

title: Four Children with Autism Create History with 60-Km International Sea Swim
excerpt: In an inspiring and historic achievement, four young children with autism successfully completed a 60-kilometer two-way international open water relay swim across the Palk Strait, earning global recognition from the World Book of Records.
content:
The event, titled “Waves of Hope – India ↔ Sri Lanka Two-Way Sea Swim,” was organized by Yadhavi Foundation and Yadhavi Sports Academy for Special Needs in association with the Indian Autism Center. The certificate of achievement was presented by Dr. Suchita Shukla, Dr. Priyanka Shukla, and Dr. Tithi Shukla.

The young achievers Master Gunturu Lav, Master Gunturu Kush, Master Meka Sri Ashvath, and Master Thanvesh N., aged between 9 and 11 completed the relay in a continuous 24-hour format. The swim began at Arichal Munai on April 18 at 3:30 PM and concluded on April 19 at 9:27 AM.

Facing strong currents, unpredictable weather, and night-time swimming, the children demonstrated remarkable endurance and determination. After eight months of intensive training in pools and open waters, their achievement stands as a global first for children with autism.

Supported medically by Dr. Kamakshi Memorial Hospital, the event ensured complete safety throughout. More than a record, “Waves of Hope” sends a powerful message: Disability is not inability, inspiring greater awareness, inclusion, and belief in the limitless potential of every child.
author: Rhea Menon

title: Spiritual Leader’s Universal Service and Sacred Contributions Receive International Recognition
excerpt: His Holiness Beloved SP Maestro MahaaGURU Ji, known for his emphasis on universal values, ethical living, and compassionate service, continues to draw attention for his sustained spiritual and humanitarian contributions across India and abroad.
content:
Rooted in principles of universal unity, integrity, and disciplined self-governance, His Holiness Beloved SP Maestro MahaaGURU Ji has, since 2002, established multiple spiritual, contemplative, and social service institutions. These include meditation centres in India and the United States, youth empowerment organisations focused on leadership and skill development, and women empowerment platforms promoting personal and economic growth.

Over the years, regular spiritual discourses, meditation workshops, and long-term yogic science programmes have been conducted under his guidance. Educational and character-development initiatives for youth, along with community-based empowerment programmes for women, have formed a structured part of his outreach.

In addition to spiritual initiatives, several humanitarian programmes have been undertaken, including food distribution drives, healthcare assistance, educational support for students, livelihood development initiatives, and family assistance programmes for underprivileged communities.

A major milestone in his spiritual work has been the conceptualisation and documentation of 1,003 Mahaa Mudras, a structured body of sacred symbolic practices. This contribution, along with sustained sacred fire observances (Yajnas/Havans) conducted with disciplined regularity across multiple centres, received formal recognition from the World Book of Records UK. The honour was conferred at the House of Commons, United Kingdom.

Observers note that His Holiness Beloved SP Maestro MahaaGURU Ji’s work reflects an integrated approach combining spiritual discipline, social responsibility, and universal human values positioning his initiatives as a continuing contribution toward ethical awareness and compassionate global citizenship.
author: Marta Ruiz

title: Padma Shri Sadhguru Brahmeshanand Acharya Ji Honoured by World Book of Records at UK Parliament
excerpt: One of the world’s most respected democratic institutions Padma Shri Sadhguru Brahmeshanand Acharya Ji, who arrived from Goa, India, was formally honoured with a World Book of Records Certificate of Excellence.
content:
The honour was presented in the distinguished presence of H.H. Rajrajeshwar Guru Ji of the International Siddhashram Shakti Centre UK, acknowledging Sadhguru Ji’s profound spiritual leadership, humanitarian service, and social contributions. The ceremony was graced by several eminent dignitaries, including Simon N. Ovens DL, His Majesty King Charles III’s Representative for Harrow, Gareth Thomas, Member of Parliament for Harrow West, Senior Labour Party statesman and distinguished five-time British MP Virendra Sharma and Councillor Janet Mote, Harrow Council.

Representatives from diverse faith communities and leading community organisations were also present, reflecting the widespread respect Sadhguru Ji commands across spiritual and social spheres. CEO Santosh Shukla of the World Book of Records extended his warm congratulations on this prestigious recognition.
author: Li Wei

title: Machavaram Sree Tulasi Sahasra included in World Book of Records UK
excerpt: Eluru Girl Sets Remarkable Record in 700 shlokas of the Bhagavad Gita in an impressive 52 minutes and 4 seconds
content:
Miss Machavaram Sree Tulasi Sahasra, daughter of Satish Kumar Machavaram from Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, has achieved a remarkable feat by being included in World Book of Records UK, for being the fastest to recite 700 shlokas of the Bhagavad Gita in an impressive 52 minutes and 4 seconds. The certificate was bestowed by WBR Chartered Officer Dr. Jitendra Matlani, along with renowned actress Nithya Shetty, in a felicitation ceremony held in Hyderabad.

This extraordinary accomplishment highlights Miss Sree Tulasi Sahasra’s deep devotion, memory power, and dedication towards preserving India’s spiritual heritage. Her achievement serves as a source of pride for her family, her hometown Eluru, and the entire nation.
author: Suresh Iyer

title: World Book of Records Recognizes ISKCON for Largest Online Bhagavad Gita Quiz Participation
excerpt: Surat, Gujarat: World Book of Records has officially honoured the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON) for achieving a historic milestone by organizing the Largest Participation in an Online Bhagavad Gita Quiz.
content:
An unprecedented 3,99,000 students from over 2,000 schools across India and abroad participated in the unique online initiative. The quiz was designed to help young learners explore the timeless teachings of the Bhagavad Gita, while instilling values of knowledge, discipline, and moral integrity.

Certificate was bestowed to Murtimandas, President Iskcon Varachha by WBR officials Rajesh Shukla and Dr. Rajeev Shrivastav. In presenting the record certificate, World Book of Records commended ISKCON for its vision and dedication in mobilizing such a massive educational and spiritual engagement. The organization’s efforts were lauded as a powerful example of how technology can bridge tradition and modernity, inspiring youth worldwide to connect with cultural and spiritual heritage. This global recognition not only underscores the universal relevance of the Bhagavad Gita but also sets a shining example of collective participation in spiritual learning. World Book of Records extended heartfelt congratulations to ISKCON on this extraordinary accomplishment, acknowledging its vital role in spreading the light of the Bhagavad Gita to future generations.
author: Mei Lin

title: Kuresi Vinay Kumar sets remarkable record with 2 Hours 26 minutes in Padmasana
excerpt: In an extraordinary display of discipline and inner strength, Kuresi Vinay Kumar achieved the longest duration holding Padmasana (Lotus Pose) continuously 2 hours and 26 minutes
content:
In a fast-paced world, where movement defines progress, Vinay Kumar’s accomplishment stands out as a powerful celebration of stillness. Rooted deeply in ancient yogic traditions, Padmasana is a posture symbolizing spiritual awakening, stability, and inner harmony. While most practitioners find it challenging to maintain the pose beyond 20–30 minutes, sustaining it for over two hours requires exceptional flexibility, breath control, and mental endurance.

Throughout the record-setting attempt, Vinay Kumar remained composed and unwavering. His posture stayed aligned, his breathing steady, and his focus undisturbed as time passed. The serene ambiance of the meditation center amplified the significance of the moment there were no outward signs of strain, only a profound demonstration of control and resilience.

Witnesses described the feat as both inspiring and humbling. Beyond the record itself, the achievement embodied the true essence of yoga the union of body, mind, and breath. In an era often driven by speed and constant activity, Vinay Kumar’s success highlights a deeper truth: that mastery can also be found in patience, silence, and sustained stillness.

His 2-hour-26-minute Padmasana milestone serves as a lasting inspiration, reminding many that true strength lies not just in motion, but in the ability to remain perfectly still.
author: Alex Kim
